# English pilot run outputs

These are unchanged copies of three completed English-language pilot runs from
`results/pilot_live/`. Each directory contains the complete experiment output:
`config.resolved.yaml`, `meta.json`, `metrics.json`, `tasks.jsonl`, `trace.jsonl`,
and every generated candidate program.

They cover the same six ConDefects tasks and serve as stable input for a future
trace visualizer. The committed copies contain no API keys or authorization
headers. As exact copies, each resolved configuration retains the original
non-secret Docker cache path `/app/.cache/llm`.
